aftermath_trace.ko: 기존 쓸기 접점에 이어지는 비워진 띠와 모인 마른 잔여물
aftermath_trace.en: a relatively cleared swath adjoins a modest gathered ridge of the same dry debris at the existing sweeping contact
concept_units: The already established operator uses the same cleaning broom or hand brush in the same ongoing dry sweep of the existing loose debris on its supporting surface.
The tool-to-surface contact, sweep direction, operator configuration and active sweeping phase are already established and remain unchanged.
The existing view already shows that working contact and the adjacent supporting surface.
On that same visible surface, the same loose dry debris forms a modest gathered ridge adjoining a relatively cleared swath.
The cleared swath and gathered ridge align with the existing sweeping contact and direction, linking two residue regions of that same operation.

aftermath_trace.ko: 기존 쓰레받기 턱을 지나 안쪽까지 이어지는 같은 마른 잔여물
aftermath_trace.en: sparse dry residue on the source surface aligns through the already seated dustpan lip with a modest deposit inside the same pan
concept_units: The already established operator uses the same cleaning broom or hand brush to collect the existing loose dry debris from the same supporting surface into the same dustpan.
The dustpan lip already rests against that source surface, and the existing view already shows the source surface, receiving lip and pan interior together.

The same active collection phase already has some of that debris on the source surface and some inside the pan; the operator configuration, brush approach, tool contacts, receiver position and phase remain unchanged.
A sparse remainder on the source surface, a few grains at the already seated lip and a modest deposit inside the same pan align along the established collection path.
The three residue regions remain parts of the same source-to-pan collection, with the existing tool, receiver and supporting contact retained.
